setup_reads_note: Keys no compose file interpolates but `vizra setup` itself reads at the commit above. They count as consumed for template-key-unused. Do not add a key here without a file:function in vizra-core that reads it.
unread_keys_note: FINDING for vizra-core: the interview writes these but nothing reads them at source_commit (no compose interpolation, no core registry key, no setup code path). They are deliberately NOT in the template - a key nobody reads is a lie an operator can act on. Each leaves this list when its reader lands (storage, mail, registration, import, ClickHouse/IPFS and managed/external selection slices); setup-key-untemplated fails on any written key that is in neither the template nor this list.
